paragraphs.text: As all the fruits of the season come to us in their proper time, flowers in spring, grain in summer, and apples in autumn, so the fruit for winter is talk.

source.source_note: Source. Translated by Blomfield Jackson. From Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, Second Series, Vol. 8. Edited by Philip Schaff and Henry Wace. (Buffalo, NY: Christian Literature Publishing Co., 1895.) Revised and edited for New Advent by Kevin Knight. <http://www.newadvent.org/fathers/3202013.htm>.

latex.p0004: 正如季节的所有果实都在它们适当的时间来临：春天有花朵，夏天有谷物，秋天有苹果，而冬天的果实就是交谈。
